title: 第17章 伍子胥第18章 壮士你快跳江吧
slug: 西游刚准备尸解成仙猴子来找
content_zh:
却说那范蠡引开了楚国甲士，将那重伤的伍子胥藏匿妥当暂且按下不表。
单说这陶潜老道，赶走了徒弟，独个儿盘腿坐在街角，迫不及待将袖中那卷《捭阖》竹简摸了出来。
双手一展，但见那竹简上金光乱迸，一个个古篆字好似活脱脱的蝌蚪，扭动跳跃。
老道正定睛细看，猛然间，一股沛然莫御的吸力从简中涌出。陶潜只觉天旋地转，“嗖”的一声，一缕神识竟被生生拽入了竹简之中！
待定下神来，四周茫茫荡荡，只见那清浊二气翻滚，阴阳两仪交汇。
密密麻麻的金字如星辰般环绕周身，真个是字字珠玑，句句玄妙。
这《捭阖》之道，不是术法，乃是阐述天地阴阳开合、万物生灭之理的大道思想！开则为捭，阴阳化生；闭则为阖，万物归藏。
此刻陶潜也不由看的如痴如醉，沉浸其中，连肉身在街头风吹日晒也全然不知。
不知不觉，那日头早已落了西山，玉兔东升，满街商贩散尽，夜色深沉。
范蠡在客栈左等右等不见师傅回来，只得趁着夜色寻到西市口。
借着月光一看，好家伙！自家那便宜师傅正跟个泥塑木雕似的盘在地上，双目紧闭，手中那卷竹简正隐隐泛着金光。
范蠡蹑手蹑脚凑上前，咽了口唾沫，暗道：“这老抠门定是得了什么仙家宝贝，待我瞧瞧是个什么稀罕物！”
说罢，伸出一只贼手，悄咪咪地便往那竹简上摸去。
指尖刚要触到，猛听得“啪”的一声脆响！
陶潜双目霍然睁开，眼中精光四射，神识已然归位。他反手抓起竹简，照着范蠡的脑门劈头就是一下！
“哎哟！”范蠡捂着脑袋蹦起三尺高，疼得直吸凉气。
“好你个小瘪犊子！老道的宝贝也敢偷拿？真个是三天不打，上房揭瓦！”陶潜骂骂咧咧。
“哎哟！老师下手好重！”范蠡捂着脑袋，却不死心，涎着脸凑上前，扯住陶潜的破道袍袖子撒娇道：“好师傅，您老人家吃肉，总得给弟子留口汤喝不是？这发光的宝贝，就让弟子瞅一眼，就一眼！”
“去你的！”陶潜哪里吃他这一套，抬起脚来，照准他屁股上又是一脚，“你这泼皮，毛都没长齐，看什么天机？还不快收拾了地摊，随老道回去睡觉！”
范蠡挨了踹，不情不愿地撅着嘴，胡乱卷起地上的破布，跟在陶潜屁股后面。师徒俩披星戴月，径回那破落客栈。

刚上得二楼，来到那四面漏风的柴房门前，陶潜正欲伸手推门，范蠡猛地浑身一激灵，好似想起了什么要命的勾当。
他一步抢上前，死死拽住陶潜的胳膊，满脸心虚，结结巴巴道：“老……老师！咱可先说好，等会儿您推开这门，不管在屋里看见个甚么骇人的物事，都千万不能动手打我！”
陶潜眉头一皱，只当这小瘪犊子又在外面捡了什么野猫野狗的破烂回来，一脸高人风范道：“老道乃是修仙得道的高人，岂会动辄打人？不打不打，快快松开！”
content_en:
But he said that Fan Li lured away the soldiers of Chu State and hid the seriously injured Wu Zixu safely.
Shan said that Tao Qian, the old master, drove away his apprentice and sat cross-legged alone on the street corner. He couldn't wait to take out the bamboo slip of "捭阖" from his sleeve.
When he stretched out his hands, he saw golden light bursting out from the bamboo slips, and each ancient seal character was like a living tadpole, twisting and jumping.
The old Taoist was taking a closer look when suddenly, an overwhelming suction force came out of the slip. Tao Qian felt the world spinning, and with a "swish" sound, a ray of consciousness was pulled into the bamboo slip!
After calming down, the surroundings were vast and wandering, and I could see the two clear and turbid qi rolling around, and the two yin and yang meeting.
Densely packed gold characters surround the body like stars, and each word is really pearl-shaped and every sentence is mysterious.
This "捭昖" method is not a magic method, but a great thought that explains the opening and closing of yin and yang in the heaven and earth, and the birth and death of all things! When it is open, it means 捭, where yin and yang are transformed; when it is closed, it means it is closed, where all things are hidden.
At this moment, Tao Qian couldn't help but be mesmerized by the sight. He was so immersed in it that he didn't even know that his body was exposed to the wind and sun on the street.
Unconsciously, the sun had already set in the west, the Jade Rabbit rose in the east, the vendors on the street had all dispersed, and the night was dark.
Fan Li waited around in the inn but couldn't see the master coming back, so he had to take advantage of the night to find Xishikou.
Take a look by the moonlight, what a guy! My cheap master was coiled on the ground like a clay or wooden sculpture, with his eyes closed, and the bamboo slips in his hand were faintly glowing with golden light.
Fan Li tiptoed forward, swallowed, and said to himself: "This stingy old man must have got some fairy treasure. Let me see what kind of rare thing it is!"
After that, he stretched out his hand and quietly touched the bamboo slip.
Just when my fingertips were about to touch it, I heard a crisp "pop" sound!
Tao Qian's eyes suddenly opened, his eyes were shining with light, and his consciousness had returned to its original position. He grabbed the bamboo slip with his backhand and hit Fan Li on the head!
"Ouch!" Fan Li covered his head and jumped three feet high, gasping in pain.
"You little brat! Do you dare to steal this treasure even if you are a seasoned person? If you don't fight for three days, you will have to go to the house and uncover the tiles!" Tao Qian cursed.
"Ouch! The teacher is so harsh!" Fan Li covered his head, but did not give up. He came forward with a salivating face, grabbed the sleeves of Tao Qian's broken Taoist robe and said coquettishly: "Good master, if you eat meat, you have to leave a mouthful of soup for the disciples to drink, right? Let the disciples take a look at this luminous treasure, just one look!"
"Fuck you!" Tao Qian couldn't resist what he was doing. He raised his foot and aimed another kick at his butt. "You're such a rascal. Your hair isn't all grown up. What's the secret? Why don't you clean up the stall and go back to sleep with me!"
Fan Li was kicked, reluctantly pouted, rolled up the rags on the ground, and followed Tao Qian. Master and disciple, wearing stars and moon, walked back to the dilapidated inn.
As soon as they reached the second floor and came to the door of the firewood shed that was leaking from all sides, Tao Qian was about to reach out and push the door open when Fan Li suddenly trembled all over, as if he remembered something fatal.
He stepped forward, grabbed Tao Qian's arm, with a guilty look on his face, and stammered: "Old...teacher! Let's agree in advance that when you open this door later, no matter what scary thing you see in the room, you must not hit me!"
Tao Qian frowned, thinking that this little kid had picked up some tatters from wild cats and dogs outside, and said with a master's demeanor: "The old Taoist is a master who has cultivated immortality, how can he hit people at every turn? If you don't want to hit, let go quickly!"
